entities.summary: Dame Meena Upadhyaya is an Indian-born Welsh medical geneticist and a professor emerita at Cardiff University. Her research has focused on the genes that cause various genetic disorders, in particular neurofibromatosis type I and facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy.
